description: ControllerDiagnostics optimizer objective metrics from mm_events.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time", stage AS metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'value'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'value'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY['initial','final']) AS stage
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'value'] IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time",
  comp.key AS metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(comp.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(comp.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(
    e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','objective','contribution_fractions'],
    e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','objective','final','contribution_fractions'],
    '{}'::jsonb
  )
) AS comp(key, value)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", stage AS metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'components','risk_adjusted_return'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'components','risk_adjusted_return'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY['initial','final']) AS stage
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'components','risk_adjusted_return'] IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,field], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,field], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY['initial','final']) AS stage
CROSS JOIN (
  VALUES ('main_reward_mean', 'main_reward_mean'), ('global_reward_mean', 'global_reward_mean')
) AS fields(metric, field)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,field] IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", kv.key AS metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','rollout','joint_diagnostics'], '{}'::jsonb)
) AS kv
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

list.definition:
SELECT actor_id
FROM (
  SELECT actor_id, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT actor_id, updated_at AS latest_ts
  FROM registry_strategies
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND actor_id IS NOT NULL
    AND actor_id <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE actor_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(actor_id AS text) <> ''
  GROUP BY actor_id
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
